title: SHG and Sure Sign Memorandum of Understanding to Progress St Helena Telecommunications Upgrade
lineage: Original publication on the issuing organisation’s website.

passages.locator: Opening, funding and Sure chief executive’s statement
passages.note: Government and Sure signed a memorandum for a domestic broadband and mobile upgrade to use Equiano capacity better. The operator aimed to begin deploying in early 2027 and see the first customer benefits by mid-2027. These dates were targets.
